reason: The README describes an agent orchestration plugin that performs multi-sampled model calls with internal voting and coordinates plan, execute, and review phases through dsh lifecycle hooks.

summaries.zh: 通过多次采样、内部投票以及计划、执行和审查阶段来编排 dsh 智能体工作流。
summaries.en: Orchestrates dsh agent workflows by combining multi-sampled model outputs, internal voting, and plan, execute, and review phases.

capabilities: scores and selects candidate reasoning chains
injects selected plans into agent execution
runs plan, execute, and review phases
records requests, usage, decisions, and phase state in session events
